navaid.name: USCGC Scioto
navaid.description: USCGC Scioto is a 65' river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Mississippi River from Alton, IL to Clinton, IA.

navaid.name: USCGC Wyaconda
navaid.description: USCGC Wyaconda is a 75' river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Mississippi River from Clinton, IA to Minneapolis, MN; the Minnesota River to Shakopee, MN; and the St. Croix River to Stillwater, MN.
